decisions.reason: As a newly launched automation product tightly aligned with the firm's integrated precast-plant strategy, it still has option value under uncertainty and is likely worth keeping while market feedback develops.

The product fits the firm's established automation offer, but its narrower scope and overlap with other robot variants make portfolio consolidation somewhat more plausible than for the flagship combined solution.

This robot complements the broader automated production workflow, so in a growing industry and within a broad solution portfolio the firm is likely to retain it while demand potential becomes clearer.

Like the automatic de-shuttering robot, it extends the existing offer but may face some internal substitution risk versus the combined robot, so the firm is likely to keep it for now though with a moderate chance of later rationalization.
